title: Soccer Battle Online
seo_title: Soccer Battle Online — Play Free Soccer Game Online
meta_desc: Play Soccer Battle Online free in your browser. Pass, tackle and shoot in fast-paced football matches against the AI or a friend on one keyboard.
desc: Soccer Battle Online drops you into quick football matches where every pass, tackle and shot counts. Pick your jersey, take the field, and battle through arcade-paced games.
howto: Press K to pass or switch player.
Press J to shoot at goal.
Tackle opponents to win the ball back.
Outscore your opponent before the clock ends.
tips: Pass to move defenders, then shoot into the gap.
Switch to the player nearest the ball constantly.
Shoot across the keeper rather than straight at them.
